name: Kalimat Prayer Times API
description: Enterprise-grade prayer times infrastructure trusted by high-traffic platforms. Accepts latitude, longitude, and ISO country code to automatically resolve the nearest supported city within that country, returning precise daily prayer timetables in the resolved city's local timezone for today, a single date, or date ranges.

authentication.description: Requires an API key passed in the X-Api-Key HTTP header. Keys can be requested via info@kalimat.dev.

rateLimit.policy: Tiered by enterprise subscription with high-availability SLAs.

endpoints.name: Get Prayer Times
endpoints.description: Retrieves prayer times for today, a specific Gregorian date, or a date range by resolving nearest supported city.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. SA, US, GB, EG)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Specific date (YYYY-MM-DD). Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date. Omit for today.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with end_date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be paired with start_date.

endpoints.name: Get Prayer Times Data Version
endpoints.description: Returns version and build metadata of the underlying prayer times calculation dataset.
